about: The industries Tobler offers (Settings → Industry). An industry is a profile: which screening method runs, its themes, quick picks, distances, must-check layers, welcome examples and wording. Tools and the atlas are shared. Only profiles with status 'ready' can be chosen; the rest show as 'coming soon'. Designed 20 Nov 2026; the list is Rob's sector table (22 Nov). The ready profile keeps the id 'energy' so stored choices, run records and share links stay valid.
